# SnipFor

> SnipFor is a fast, lightweight, privacy-first screen capture, local OCR, annotation, and screen recording tool for Windows (10 and 11, 64-bit). Built around a strict "Zero Data Leak" architecture: all image processing, text extraction, and video recording happen 100% locally on device. No telemetry, no cloud dependencies, no accounts required.

Current Version: v2.6.9

## Core Philosophy: Privacy & Zero Data Leak
- **100% Offline Processing**: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) and annotations never transmit data over the network.
- **Enterprise-Safe**: Suitable for healthcare, legal, finance, and engineering workflows handling confidential credentials, PII, or internal documents.
- **Lightweight & Native Performance**: Instant hotkey triggering, high-DPI scaling across multi-monitor setups, and minimal system resource footprint.

## Key Features & Capabilities

### 1. Smart Capture (Intelligent UI Snapping)
- Automatic edge and UI element detection (windows, buttons, toolbars, dialogs) with sub-pixel magnetic snapping.
- Multi-monitor support across mixed DPI and refresh rates.
- Shortcut: PrintScreen or customizable hotkeys.
- Video Guide: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OXdQYAXItvI

### 2. Embedded Local OCR (Text Extraction)
- Fully offline optical character recognition powered by an embedded engine.
- Instantly grab non-selectable text from images, locked PDFs, remote desktop sessions (RDP/VNC), error dialogs, or video streams directly to clipboard.
- Shortcut: `Ctrl+T` or OCR button in toolbar.
- Video Guide: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YuRTGu9kRRM

### 3. Pin to Screen (Float on Top)
- Pin any captured snippet or region as a frameless, always-on-top floating window.
- Reposition, resize, or adjust transparency while continuing work in other applications.
- Shortcut: `P` or Pin button.
- Video Guide: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zq8oMEcLa10

### 4. Privacy Blur & Pixelate Masking
- Instantly redact API keys, passwords, personal customer data, emails, and sensitive UI elements.
- Dual masking modes: Gaussian blur or mosaic pixelation with adjustable intensity.
- Shortcut: `B`
- Video Guide: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L2eR_Uvdxqo

### 5. Step Numbering & Sequence Stamps
- Auto-incrementing numbered badge stamps (1, 2, 3...) designed for creating technical tutorials, bug reports, and step-by-step documentation in seconds.
- Shortcut: `S`
- Video Guide: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AQLsXJ42mXA

### 6. Precision Drawing & Annotations
- Vector arrows, rectangles, ellipses, callout badges, freehand pen, and semi-transparent highlighters.
- Full 30-step undo/redo buffer (`Ctrl+Z`, `Ctrl+Y`).
- Video Guide: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-jxY8GqkiFo

### 7. Color Picker & Pixel Magnifier
- High-precision screen loupe magnifier showing individual pixels and grid coordinates.
- Copy colors in HEX (`#FFFFFF`), RGB (`rgb(255,255,255)`), or HSV formats directly to clipboard with a single click.
- Shortcut: `C`
- Video Guide: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aAkrnHaxqso

### 8. Rich Typography & Text Annotations
- Inline editable text boxes with typography customization, contrast backgrounds, and customizable sizing.
- Shortcut: `T`
- Video Guide: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=h94a5fUZPRQ

### 9. Screen Video Recorder (SnipFor Pro)
- High-definition screen recording at up to 60 FPS (MP4 / GIF output).
- Area selection, active window capture, and multi-display recording with clear system audio capture.
- Lightweight encoder with zero background impact.

## Editions & Licensing

- **Community Edition** (Free & Open Source / GPLv3):
  - Full screenshot capture suite, multi-monitor support.
  - Complete annotation toolkit (arrows, shapes, text, stamps, blur).
  - 100% offline Local OCR engine.
  - Pin-to-screen floating widgets.
  - Free forever, no registration, no advertisements.

- **Pro Edition**:
  - Adds HD Screen Video & GIF Recording (60 FPS, multi-monitor, window audio capture).
  - Lifetime license with automatic updates.
  - Available at https://snipfor.com

- **Audit & Enterprise Edition**:
  - Custom commercial distribution for corporate compliance, MSI packaging, locked configurations, and air-gapped deployments.
  - Contact: mehmet@nevresoglu.net
